description: Add automated compatibility checks and documented smoke scenarios for English and Chinese project knowledge. Verification must cover conversation and document language differences legacy configuration migration stable protocols and distribution parity.
acceptance_criteria: Automated tests verify the document_language configuration contract and legacy compatibility path
Static checks verify stable JSON keys enum values IDs paths and evidence across language modes
Documented smoke scenarios cover English documents Chinese documents and Chinese conversation with English documents
Repository tests and git diff --check pass without requiring new runtime dependencies
notes: Human acceptance passed on 2026-08-26. Added methodology/06-document-language-smoke-scenarios.md with English-document, Simplified-Chinese-document, Chinese-conversation/English-document, and Legacy missing-configuration scenarios. Paired fixtures prove that only document_language and human-readable values vary while JSON keys, enums, Feature IDs, dependencies, paths, timestamps, placeholder prefixes, and completion evidence remain stable. Legacy before/after fixtures prove that migration adds only document_language and preserves unknown fields without translating history. Automated tests verify all fixtures, Bootstrap and Methodology compatibility rules, verified/invalid language tags, smoke coverage, and exact canonical-body parity for all nine native Skill/portable Prompt pairs. Automated verification: all 63 repository tests passed; JSON and git diff checks passed; no new runtime dependencies were added. Code smell scan: pass (feature: F025, must_fix: 0, suggest: 2, acceptable: 0). Non-blocking suggestions: discover workflow pairs from both distribution directories and validate each smoke scenario as an isolated structured section.
